title: Merged-face suppression for served mine_revamp_c9a9394e.glb when keeping Base_Paint / Base_GlowCyan alongside v3h

served_glb.note: No Draco. Positions on these primitives decode via meshopt ATTRIBUTES + EXPONENTIAL filter to float32 (accessor componentType 5126); KHR_mesh_quantization does not rescale them.

decode.runtime: THREE.GLTFLoader with MeshoptDecoder (GLTFLoader.js GLTFMeshoptCompression.loadBufferView calls MeshoptDecoder.decodeGltfBuffer / decodeGltfBufferAsync)
decode.this_pass: meshoptimizer 1.2 MeshoptDecoder.decodeGltfBuffer — same decoder and arguments the loader uses
decode.gltfpack_noq: gltfpack 1.3 -noq -kn -km -ke of the official packed file was compared. Triangle SET is identical; vertex and index ORDER are not. Paint vertex count changed 7056 -> 7049 (7 welded).
decode.vertex_index_order_vs_GLTFLoader: Use the meshoptimizer/Three.js decode of the official packed bytes. Do not assume gltfpack -noq preserves order.

recommended_reason: Matches the original Blender cut_faces_in_box predicate (world-space face centroid inside an inclusive AABB). Stable across meshopt decode, gltfpack -noq, and any future re-pack/quantize. A connected-island list is unnecessary: the authoring boxes already isolate hopper/silo/supports/scrap (v3) plus the earlier derrick/pad/scrap (v1/v2). A split would be an art export, which this pass does not do.

raw_triangle_index_masks.valid_after_meshopt_decode_of_this_exact: Yes — Three.js GLTFLoader of md5 c9a9394e3635f99f59423a4630ae6ae7 produces a deterministic vertex/index order, so a mask of triangle slots would drop the intended faces on that exact decode.
raw_triangle_index_masks.evidence: gltfpack -noq -kn -km -ke reordered both primitives and welded 7 Base_Paint vertices (7056 vs 7049) while keeping the same 8305/1874 triangle set. A raw index mask from the unpack would delete the wrong triangles in GLTFLoader.

face_test.predicate: For each triangle, compute the world-space centroid of its three vertices. Drop the triangle if the centroid is inside ANY listed AABB (inclusive on all six faces).
face_test.source: /workspace/art_next/mine_drill_concept_1107/_src/build_drill_concept_v3.py cut_faces_in_box (lines 32-55) and the v3 PLANT/TEAL boxes (lines 155-171). v1 and v2 used the same function with different boxes.
face_test.parent_filter: Only meshes whose parent name starts with Base_Paint or Base_GlowCyan. On the served GLB that is one unnamed mesh child each (Three.js: Base_Paint.children[0], Base_GlowCyan.children[0]; Blender import names Mesh_1 and Mesh_0).
face_test.transforms: Served parent empties and mesh children have identity transforms, so local == world == glTF +Y-up coordinates. Still multiply by mesh.matrixWorld so a later scene offset stays correct.

v3_plant.what: Hopper cone+legs+pipe, silo/dome, chute supports, leftover teal scrap near the old hopper foot. Everything plant-side of the drill (blender x > -5.40). Do not treat this layer as a drill-side cut.
v3_plant.script: build_drill_concept_v3.py PLANT + TEAL, applied after named hides, on meshes that had already received the v1 and v2 cuts (v3 was a copy of v2).

v1_v2_prior.what: Old merged derrick/mast (v1 DERRICK_BOX + DERRICK_TALL), circular pad scraps (v1 PAD_BOX, v2 PAD_A + PAD_B), leftover drill-side scrap (v2 SCRAP). Already applied in the v2 blend that v3 copied, so they never appear in v3/v3h study meshes.
v1_v2_prior.reason: Named-node hides (Rig, Conveyor, Silo, …) do not remove these fragments; they live inside the merged Base_Paint / Base_GlowCyan primitives. Applying only the v3 boxes leaves them in game.

TEAL.note: leftover cyan scrap near old hopper foot; extends 0.40 m further in -X than PLANT

remaining_after_full_union_centroid_aabb.note: Low drill-side ground skirt outside the v1/v2 pad boxes. Matches the 315 faces left on Mesh_1 in mine_drill_concept_v3.blend and v3h.blend.

primitives.note: After the recommended full AABB union this primitive is empty. Hiding the Base_GlowCyan node is visually equivalent. The v3 and v3h study blends already store Mesh_0 with 0 faces and 0 verts.

count_reconciliation.explanation: Those remembered totals are the incremental V3_PLANT_CUT (PLANT ∪ TEAL) printed after v3 ran on a copy of the already-cut v2 blend, not the raw served primitives. On the meshopt-decoded served file, PLANT ∪ TEAL contains 4773 paint + 1197 glow triangles, of which 132 paint + 155 glow also sit in a v1/v2 box and had already been deleted before the v3 script ran. Incremental = 4773-132 = 4641 paint (exact) and 1197-155 = 1042 glow (one more than the remembered 1041).
count_reconciliation.glow_off_by_one: The extra glow triangle is index 669 in the Three.js-decoded Base_GlowCyan primitive. Its centroid is (-5.0824, 1.2904, -1.3971) in glTF coordinates, 2.9 mm outside DERRICK_BOX (nearest prior box). A Blender import of a gltfpack -noq unpack (which the authoring pipeline used, because Blender 4.2 cannot decode meshopt) can nudge that centroid across the box face, so the logged V3_PLANT_CUT glow total can read 1041. Apply the AABB test, not a hardcoded 1041, so this boundary triangle is classified consistently.

do_not_hide_by_prefix_Conveyor: Conveyor_Gallery is the new v3h gallery and must not match a startswith('Conveyor') hide.

additional_named_hides_to_match_study.why: v1 build_drill_concept.py HIDE_NODES hid Tier_03/05/08/12/20 as served-base (Lv 1) upgrades. The v3+ study blends keep those hides. They are the detailed visual hopper (Tier_05), upgraded silo (Tier_12), tall derrick cap (Tier_20), plus Tier_03 and Tier_08. EXPORT_v3h.md said to keep the Tiers; that resurrects hopper and silo even after the merged-face AABB cut and the Silo/Conveyor/Chute/Rig hides.

child_meshes_after_blender_import.Tier_20: Mesh_9 (tall derrick cap, blender Z 13.53–21.78 at the old Rig XY)

additional_named_hides_to_match_study.in_three_js: scene.getObjectByName('Tier_05') etc. — hide the named empty and its mesh child (same unnamed-child pattern as Base_Paint).

eye_check.with_study_hides: PASS: no old hopper, silo, circular pad, derrick or plant supports. New v3h drill, gallery and funnel remain. 315 leftover Base_Paint triangles are a low drill-side ground skirt (glTF centroid AABB x[-12.07,-5.43], y[-0.05,0.60], z[-9.02,-6.90]), not plant.
eye_check.export_named_hides_without_tiers: FAIL for hopper/silo: Tier_05 (hopper) and Tier_12 (silo) stay visible. See export_hides_only images.
